messages.subject: SEM function
parts:
Dear all,
I am looking into the mathematical background of SEM. I was wondering if anyone knows what the sem function in the lavaan package exactly does? All I know now is that it fits the model and to do that it uses the maximum likelihood as fitting function.
Thank you in advance!

messages.author: ad188126f9138663
messages.subject: Re: SEM function
parts:
Vera,
  If you have already read an introductory SEM text, Rick Hoyle's handbook offers a good bridge to primary literature.  Chapter 10 by Lei & Wu offers an accessible overview of estimation.

Hoyle, R. (2012).  Handbook of structural equation modeling. New York:  Guildford.

Keith
